verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials describe this exact flow: a vendor invoice is dragged in, automatically matched to its PO, coded to the right GL account, routed for approval, and paid. That is backed by AI agents for auto-coding, approval routing and automatic payment, by agents learning from past invoices, and by a bill-payments API plus CLI commands for bills and purchase orders. However, the PO-matching claim rests on marketing-level copy, and bill approvals are not yet available via MCP. missing for 10: in-depth docs on PO-matching logic (e.g. 2-/3-way matching, exception handling), independent or hands-on corroboration of invoice-to-PO matching, bill approvals through the MCP agent channel.
